description: This file defines a WebSocket-based real-time update system for a Tic-Tac-Toe game backend, including a connection manager class, a websocket route, and a utility to emit events to connected clients.

classes.name: ConnectionManager
classes.description: Manages WebSocket connections for game subscriptions, allowing clients to connect, disconnect, and broadcast messages to subscribers of specific game IDs.

methods.name: connect(self, websocket: WebSocket, game_id: int)
methods.description: Accepts a WebSocket connection and registers it under a specific game ID.

methods.name: disconnect(self, websocket: WebSocket, game_id: int)
methods.description: Removes a WebSocket connection from the game subscription list.

methods.name: broadcast(self, game_id: int, message: dict)
methods.description: Sends a JSON message to all WebSocket connections subscribed to a particular game ID.

methods.name: websocket_game_updates(websocket: WebSocket, game_id: int)
methods.description: WebSocket endpoint allowing clients to receive real-time game updates via subscriptions, handling incoming messages and disconnections.

methods.name: emit_game_event(game_id: int, event: str, payload: dict)
methods.description: Utility function to broadcast game events (like moves or game over) to all clients subscribed to a specific game.

ctags.name: broadcast
ctags.pattern: /^    async def broadcast(self, game_id: int, message: dict):$/

ctags.name: connect
ctags.pattern: /^    async def connect(self, websocket: WebSocket, game_id: int):$/

ctags.name: disconnect
ctags.pattern: /^    def disconnect(self, websocket: WebSocket, game_id: int):$/

ctags.name: emit_game_event
ctags.pattern: /^async def emit_game_event(game_id: int, event: str, payload: dict):$/
